## Checklist

- [ ] Decisions go to `00-overview/DECISION-LOG.md` as a new ADR; existing ADRs are never edited, only superseded

- [ ] `python 00-overview/scripts/check_links.py` passes (links, em-dashes, table pipes)

- [ ] ClickUp re-synced for every changed page (`03-delivery/CLICKUP.md`)
